subject: Mutual action plan: environment bootstrap & acceptance play
messages:
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa@medframe.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff + environment details request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. As discussed, MedFrame is aligned to move forward with a 6-week evaluation; we'd like to lock the mutual action plan and get the POC environment bootstrapped this week so our engineering team can start ingesting sample traffic. High-level asks from our side:

- Temporary API keys for evaluation (ephemeral, 2-week TTL)
- Org-level setup so we can invite 3 engineers to the org console
- IP allowlist entries (we'll provide CIDR ranges)
- VPC peering or private link—our infra team prefers peering if possible

I've attached our proposed acceptance criteria and a simple network diagram. Can your team confirm turnaround and any prerequisites from your side?

Appreciate it—
Lisa
Lisa Moreno
Head of Infrastructure, MedFrame
lisa@medframe.com
Attachment: medframe_map_v1.pdf

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa@medframe.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + environment details request

Hi Lisa — thanks, this is great context. Per our call and your MAP doc, here's a concrete plan and timeline we can commit to for the 6-week evaluation:

Week 0 (this week) — Environment bootstrap
- Generate ephemeral API keys (team-scoped) and share in secure channel
- Create org and invite your three engineers (role: Org Developer)
- Provide IP allowlist template and request CIDRs by EOD Thu
- Start VPC peering request (we support peering + cross-account route tables)

Week 1 — Integration & smoke tests
- SDK quickstart and sample workloads
- Validate prefix caching and KV cache for sample flows

Weeks 2-4 — Load testing and evaluation runs
- Shared dashboards, latency/cost baselines, quality checks against your prompts

Weeks 5-6 — Wrap-up & close criteria
- Regression check, final report, and decision meeting

Next steps I will action today:
1) Attach an environment bootstrap checklist and the VPC peering diagram (see vpc_peering_diagram.png).
2) Ben (cc'd) will follow up with the exact CIDR/peering configuration we need on our side and the acceptance tests for peering.
3) I'll provision two ephemeral API keys and share expiry instructions (attached as api_key_instructions.txt).

Questions: Do you need cross-account IAM roles, or will you use your VPC to route directly to our peering endpoint? Also, please confirm the three engineers' emails so I can invite them.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachment: vpc_peering_diagram.png, api_key_instructions.txt

From: Alex Turner <alex@medframe.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Lisa Moreno <lisa@medframe.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + environment details request

Hi Stephanie — thanks, that timeline works. Quick answers:

- We'll use our VPC and request peering with Redwood (no cross-account IAM needed).
- CIDR ranges: 10.12.16.0/24, 10.12.17.0/24, 10.12.18.0/24 (for eval envs).
- Engineers to invite: emma.wu@medframe.com, raj.patel@medframe.com, and mconnor@medframe.com.

Two asks from our infra lead: can you provide a small acceptance test that verifies traffic egress via the peering (simple curl to /health returning 200 and peer IP in headers)? Also, are there any expected route table changes on our side we should prepare?

Thanks —
Alex Turner
Platform Engineering, MedFrame
Attachment: none

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Turner <alex@medframe.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + environment details request

Alex — thanks for the CIDRs and the engineer list. Quick technical notes and the minimal acceptance test we'll run once peering is provisioned:

1) Peering mechanics: we'll create a peer from our VPC (vpc-ml-infer-02) to your provided CIDRs. On our side we'll advertise 172.31.240.0/22 for the evaluation cluster. No cross-account IAM required; standard route-table entries and security-group rules will suffice.

2) Route table changes you'll need: add a route for 172.31.240.0/22 -> peering-attachment (we'll provide the exact attachment ID). Also allow inbound TCP 443 from 10.12.16.0/24-10.12.18.0/24 to the inference SG.

3) Acceptance test (automation-friendly):
- From a host in CIDR 10.12.16.0/24: curl -sS -H "X-Forwarded-For: <peer-ip>" https://eval-api.redwood.example.com/health
- Expect 200 and JSON body {"status":"ok","peer":"172.31.240.10"}

4) Ephemeral API keys: we'll issue team-scoped keys that expire in 14 days. For longer runs we'll provide a rotation script.

Neha — can you pick this up for the key provisioning and share the secure link to the tokens?

-ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa@medframe.com>, Alex Turner <alex@medframe.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-03T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + environment details request — MAP confirmed and next steps

Folks — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and agreed actions to close out the bootstrap phase by EOD Friday: 

- Redwood actions (owner):
  * Provision org and invite: stephanie_nguyen (completed once Alex confirms invites accepted)
  * Create ephemeral API keys (14d TTL) and share via encrypted link: neha_kapoor
  * Open peering request and share attachment ID and expected timeline (ben_carter)
  * Publish small acceptance test and quickstart notebook to shared Drive: stephanie_nguyen

- MedFrame actions (owner):
  * Apply route table entries for 172.31.240.0/22 -> peering attachment once we send the attachment ID (Alex)
  * Provide acceptance test host and run the curl check once peering is active (Alex/Emma)

Acceptance criteria for MAP bootstrap (pass/fail):
1) Org invites accepted and three engineers have console access.
2) Ephemeral API keys issued and validated against the health endpoint.
3) VPC peering established and acceptance test returns 200 with expected peer header.
4) IP allowlist entries validated from the three engineer hosts.

Attachments: medframe_map_v1.pdf, vpc_peering_diagram.png, api_key_instructions.txt

If we hit these by EOD Friday (2026-03-05), we will mark Week 0 complete and begin integration tests Monday. I'll open a HubSpot task with the MAP milestones and reminders (link below).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/DF-2026-1294
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-map-resources

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into a production-like eval run.

Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachment: medframe_map_v1.pdf, vpc_peering_diagram.png, api_key_instructions.txt
